tickets.name: First Look
tickets.note: Wizards at Pistons, and the race to the first bucket starts at center court! Davis squares up with Collins for the opening tip, and we like Davis to control it! This opening could break either way, and we know which way we're leaning! If Davis controls the tip, he taps it to a guard, rolls to the rim, and boom, he's the first look! Davis is the lone value in this one, and we are HERE for it!

tickets.name: Set Play
tickets.note: Cavaliers at Hornets, and here's how we see the opening act! Kalkbrenner has to deal with Allen in the circle, and that's a tall order, folks! Win that tip and the Cavaliers are first in line to score. If the tip goes the Hornets' way, Allen is the guy we want letting it fly! If that first look rims out, White is right there to clean it up! Any of them scores first, and we're counting money!

tickets.name: Out of the Huddle
tickets.note: Cavaliers at Hornets, and here's how we see the opening act! Kalkbrenner has to deal with Allen in the circle, and that's a tall order, folks! Win that tip and the Cavaliers are first in line to score. If the tip goes the Hornets' way, Allen is the guy we want letting it fly! If that first look rims out, White is right there to clean it up! Any of them scores first, and we're counting money!

tickets.name: Top of the Key
tickets.note: Lights up for Lakers at Hawks, and we know exactly who we want touching the ball early! Kessler versus Okongwu for the tip, and Kessler has owned that matchup in the circle! So the Lakers should get the first crack at it. The Hawks get a stop? Then it's Okongwu running the other way for the first two! Only one man in this game beats his price, and it's Okongwu. Let's go!

tickets.name: Off the Tip
tickets.note: Grizzlies and Raptors, and the first bucket of this one has our fingerprints all over it! It's Edey against Poeltl in the circle, and neither one has the edge! Wide open at the start, and we're riding the Raptors! The Raptors' first set runs through Barrett, and he's got the green light shining bright! Barrett is the only play we like here, and we like him a lot!

tickets.name: Early Offense
tickets.note: Pacers visiting Mavericks, and we've got the opening possessions mapped out! Zubac and Gafford meet in the circle, and Zubac has been winning these jumps all season long! Toss-up at the tip, but we trust the Mavericks to cash the first trip! Washington is the sneaky finisher on that opening trip! Washington stands alone in this one, and that's plenty!

tickets.name: Ice Breaker
tickets.note: Nuggets roll into Rockets territory, and the first minute is all we care about! It starts with Jokic against Sengun at center court, and our money says Jokic gets up there first! Either side can strike first here, and we like the Nuggets to make it count! Give Jokic the tip and he's sprinting to the block. Feed the big man! One man, one bet: Jokic. Let's ride!

tickets.name: Lead the Break
tickets.note: Next up, Spurs at Suns, and the first trip down the floor is circled in red! The jump ball goes Wembanyama against Ighodaro, and Wembanyama has the springs tonight! Advantage Spurs for the opening bucket. If the Suns steal the tip or get the first stop, Ighodaro is who we want firing first! Just one play in this game, and it's Ighodaro all the way!

tickets.name: First Touch
tickets.note: Here comes Pelicans at Warriors, and the opening tip is where our night begins! Matkovic has to deal with Green in the circle, and that's a tall order, folks! It's up for grabs, and we're holding a ticket on both teams! Should Green get the tip, the ball comes right back to him. First look, baby! Should the Pelicans grab the first possession, Matkovic is our trigger man! Whoever lights it up first, the split covers the game. Let's ride!
